description: Report whether a browser tab is automation-capable, including its control owner, pending dialog, URL, title, visibility, loading state, viewport mode, and measured CSS-pixel size. Pass tabId to inspect a specific tab; omit it to use this thread's current tab. Also lists every tab in the thread (tabs) with its owner. When the user controls a tab, you can read it but not act on it until they hand it back.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

name: preview_status
title: Get preview status

description: Initialize a browser tab, which the user can watch and take over in Parallax's side panel. Pass tabId to reuse a specific existing tab, set reuseExistingTab=false to create another tab, or omit both to use this thread's current tab.

open.description: Whether to open the preview for the human. Defaults to true; set false for background-only automation.

profileId.description: Accepted for T3 compatibility; Parallax has one browser profile.

reuseExistingTab.description: Reuse tabId when supplied, otherwise this thread's current tab. Defaults to true; set false to create a new tab.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

url.description: Optional initial page URL. Absolute http(s) URL or a schemeless host such as t3.chat or localhost:5173. Schemeless public hosts use https; loopback hosts use http. Omit to open a blank tab.

name: preview_open
title: Open browser preview

description: Accept or dismiss the browser dialog reported by preview_status. For a prompt, supply promptText when accepting.

accept.description: Accept the pending browser dialog when true, or dismiss it when false.

promptText.description: Optional text to submit when accepting a prompt dialog.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

name: preview_dialog
title: Resolve browser dialog

description: Navigate a browser tab. Pass tabId to target a specific tab, plus {url:'https://t3.chat'} for a website or {target:{kind:'environment-port',port:5173}} for a dev server. Exactly one of url or target is required.

readiness.description: Readiness milestone before returning. 'load' is the default; use 'none' only when a later wait call will verify the page.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

target.description: Environment-relative target. Prefer {kind:'environment-port',port:5173} for a dev server on this host.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL or a schemeless host such as t3.chat or localhost:5173. Schemeless public hosts use https; loopback hosts use http.

path.description: Optional path, query, and fragment, for example /settings?tab=account.

port.description: Dev-server TCP port on this host.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

url.description: Website URL. Absolute http(s) URL or a schemeless host such as t3.chat or localhost:5173. Schemeless public hosts use https; loopback hosts use http.

name: preview_navigate
title: Navigate browser preview

description: Resize a browser tab, optionally selected by tabId. Use {mode:'fill'}, {mode:'freeform',width:1024,height:768}, or {mode:'preset',preset:'iphone-12-pro',orientation:'portrait'}. This changes CSS layout breakpoints without changing the browser user agent.

height.description: Freeform viewport height in CSS pixels. Required only in freeform mode.

mode.description: fill is the default 1280x800, freeform uses exact dimensions, and preset uses a named device size.

orientation.description: Orientation for a named device preset.

preset.description: Named device size. Required only when mode is preset.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

width.description: Freeform viewport width in CSS pixels. Required only in freeform mode.

name: preview_resize
title: Resize browser viewport

description: Emulate prefers-color-scheme in a browser tab, optionally selected by tabId. Use {colorScheme:'dark'} or {colorScheme:'light'}, and {colorScheme:'system'} to clear the override.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

name: preview_set_appearance
title: Set preview appearance

description: Inspect a page before interacting. Returns page state, semantic elements, an accessibilityTree outline with refs, console and network entries, action history, and screenshot dimensions. Pass locator=aria-ref=<ref> to target one exact element. Refresh refs after navigation, another snapshot, or human takeover. The text is capped near 20 KB; use preview_evaluate to read more. Set includeImage=true only when you need to see the page. Set save=true to write the PNG to disk and get back only the url and screenshotPath.

includeImage.description: Include the PNG image in the tool response. Defaults to false.

save.description: Write the screenshot PNG to disk and return its absolute path as screenshotPath. Defaults to false.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

name: preview_snapshot
title: Inspect browser page

description: Click exactly one target in the tab selected by tabId, or this thread's current tab when omitted. Prefer a locator; selector accepts CSS; x and y must be supplied together. Set button=right for a context menu or clickCount=2 for a double-click.

clickCount.description: 1 for a click, 2 for a double-click, 3 for a triple-click. Defaults to 1.

locator.description: Use locator='aria-ref=<ref>' with a ref from the latest snapshot, role=button[name='Send'], text=Sign in, or a CSS selector. Refs expire on navigation, a new snapshot, or control handoff; refresh the snapshot after a stale-ref error.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector such as button[type='submit']. Prefer locator.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

x.description: Viewport-relative X coordinate in CSS pixels. Must be paired with y.

y.description: Viewport-relative Y coordinate in CSS pixels. Must be paired with x.

name: preview_click
title: Click preview page

description: Insert literal text into one input in the tab selected by tabId, or this thread's current tab when omitted. Prefer a locator; set clear=true to replace existing text. With neither locator nor selector, types into the focused element.

clear.description: Clear the existing input value before inserting text. Defaults to false.

locator.description: Use locator='aria-ref=<ref>' with a ref from the latest snapshot, role=button[name='Send'], text=Sign in, or a CSS selector. Refs expire on navigation, a new snapshot, or control handoff; refresh the snapshot after a stale-ref error.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector such as button[type='submit']. Prefer locator.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

name: preview_type
title: Type into preview page

description: Move the mouse over exactly one target in the tab selected by tabId, or this thread's current tab when omitted, to reveal hover menus and tooltips.

locator.description: Use locator='aria-ref=<ref>' with a ref from the latest snapshot, role=button[name='Send'], text=Sign in, or a CSS selector. Refs expire on navigation, a new snapshot, or control handoff; refresh the snapshot after a stale-ref error.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector such as button[type='submit']. Prefer locator.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

x.description: Viewport-relative X coordinate in CSS pixels. Must be paired with y.

y.description: Viewport-relative Y coordinate in CSS pixels. Must be paired with x.

name: preview_hover
title: Hover preview page

description: Choose options in one native <select> by option value or visible label. Custom dropdowns are not <select>; click them open and click the option instead.

locator.description: The <select> element, for example aria-ref=<ref> or role=combobox[name='Size'].

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector for a <select>. Prefer locator.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

values.description: Option values or visible labels to select. Pass several for a multiple select, or an empty list to clear it.

name: preview_select
title: Select preview option

description: Drag one element onto another in the tab selected by tabId, or this thread's current tab when omitted.

source.description: Locator of the element to drag, for example aria-ref=<ref> from the latest snapshot.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

target.description: Locator of the element to drop onto, for example aria-ref=<ref>.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

name: preview_drag
title: Drag in preview page

description: Give files on this host to the page. After clicking an upload control, preview_status reports the open fileChooser; call this with absolute paths to answer it, or with an empty list to cancel. Pass a locator for an <input type=file> to set its files without a picker.

locator.description: Set files directly on this <input type=file> instead of answering the open file picker.

paths.description: Absolute paths of files to give the page.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector for an <input type=file>. Prefer locator.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

name: preview_upload
title: Upload files to preview page

description: Press one keyboard key in the tab selected by tabId, or this thread's current tab when omitted. Examples: {key:'Enter'}, {key:'Escape'}, or {key:'a',modifiers:['Meta']}.

key.description: Keyboard key name such as Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, Backspace, or a single character.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held while pressing key.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

name: preview_press
title: Press key in preview page

description: Scroll the tab selected by tabId, or this thread's current tab when omitted. Positive deltaY scrolls down and positive deltaX scrolls right; a locator/selector targets a container.

deltaX.description: Horizontal scroll delta in CSS pixels. Positive scrolls right. Defaults to 0.

deltaY.description: Vertical scroll delta in CSS pixels. Positive scrolls down. Defaults to 0.

locator.description: A scrollable container. Omit to scroll the viewport.

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector for a scrollable container. Omit to scroll the viewport.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

name: preview_scroll
title: Scroll preview page

description: Evaluate JavaScript in the tab selected by tabId, or this thread's current tab when omitted. Needs the same control as clicking. Returns {value} with a serializable result up to 64 KB; the expression may mutate page state.

awaitPromise.description: Await a returned Promise. Defaults to true.

expression.description: JavaScript expression evaluated in the page's main frame, for example document.title or (() => ({href: location.href}))().

returnByValue.description: Serialize and return the value instead of a remote object reference. Defaults to true.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

name: preview_evaluate
title: Evaluate JavaScript in preview

description: Wait in the tab selected by tabId, or this thread's current tab when omitted, until all supplied locator, selector, text, and URL conditions match.

locator.description: A locator that must match an element, for example role=button[name='Send'].

selector.description: Legacy CSS selector that must match an element. Prefer locator.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

text.description: Case-sensitive substring that must appear in visible document text.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000; maximum 60000.

urlIncludes.description: Substring that must appear in the current absolute URL.

name: preview_wait_for
title: Wait for preview page condition

description: Start recording the browser tab selected by tabId, or this thread's current tab when omitted.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

name: preview_recording_start
title: Start browser recording

description: Stop recording the browser tab selected by tabId, or this thread's current tab when omitted. The WebM (up to 5 MB) shows in this thread, and is written to a file on this host whose path comes back.

tabId.description: Exact browser tab to target (see preview_status tabs). Omit to use this thread's current tab.

name: preview_recording_stop
title: Stop browser recording

description: List this thread's preview tabs. Pages reflect the current state and may shift as tabs change.
name: preview_list

description: Close one preview tab owned by this thread.

tabId.description: The tab to close.

name: preview_close
